verdicts.reason: Both fail in the same ways. The maroon panel is now an empty box that holds no text. The headline sits directly on the busy photo, and 'MARKETING' runs right up to the right edge, almost cut off. The decorative circle and slash shapes are lined up in a row like icons. The CTA 'Join / WADE / team' is broken into three words spread down the right edge over a busy image. The only difference is that B's 'Join', 'WADE' and 'team' are set slightly larger and lower, which does not change the verdict.
